name: Konno Tamao
source:
The Student Council President, Konno is serious and straightforward when working at a task. He is extremely gentle, almost never gets mad, and gets surprised/flustered very easily. He is your upperclassman, and will leave in your 2nd year, though you will continue to date him while he's in college. Konno rides a bike to school, and likes it when you study hard and join student council.

[From [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]

He is the younger brother of [url=https://vndb.org/c1336]Konno Tamami[/url] from [url=http://vndb.org/v857]the first game[/url].
